protocol.policy_scope: Support-only sensitivity: support60 lowers each root/region type/instance support floor to ceil(0.6*n). All other hard constraints, taxonomy and release triggers match. Compare methods within a policy; policy changes alter the protection contract.
protocol.portfolio_scope: Post-hoc fixed maximum-window sensitivity: 5/10 m crossed with 4000 ms, selected after the original ten-case results; the original study remains unchanged.
protocol.query_category_scope: Total and immediate taxonomy families; fine-label preservation is reported separately.
protocol.recipient_scope: Conservative exact answers plus separately evaluated uniform spatial/temporal occupancy estimates. Missing support never becomes zero.
protocol.replication: One deterministic source; no population-level statistical generalization or privacy-improvement claim.

stats.support_statistics_scope: Operational observed-track support in published cell-windows/category bins; p50 is unweighted nearest rank. Not measured privacy gain or trajectory k-anonymity.

source_accounting.region_scope: Nonexclusive half-open source-point memberships; policy tests use whole-cell positive-area intersections.

independent_audit.zero_violation_scope: Every published cell is independently audited; zero releases is vacuous compliance, not successful coverage.

query_definition.source_type_contract: stable canonical terminal category per identity throughout the reference run
query_definition.public_rule: complete contained immutable space-time/category support only; no clipping or proportional allocation
query_definition.reference: sampled source; unavailable or missing measurements remain unknown
query_definition.scheduled_samples: sampling_period_ms, 2*sampling_period_ms, ... strictly before end_ms; t0 is unsampled
query_definition.cohort: interior iff query_end + max(lags) < source_horizon; EOF and censored deadlines marked

recipient_contract.exact_decoder: conservative whole-public-tile containment; not maximal transcript inference
recipient_contract.support_unit: finest Morton leaf x scheduled sample; repeated for each category query
recipient_contract.signature: bitwise union over positive intersecting volumes, plus bit 16 for unpublished support; censored and unsampled queries separate
recipient_contract.unpublished: no public record through EOF, not a claim of emptiness or a producer suppression cause
recipient_contract.lateness: seal exceeds query deadline; every diagnosed release is observed by source EOF
recipient_contract.uniform_estimate_rule: public category count x intersected leaves / public leaves x intersected scheduled samples / public scheduled samples; full visible semantically resolved support required; no missing-zero or semantic imputation
